subject: part
title: (R)PART.------AF.DYM.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-40, on the page where Braxton introduces the *affinity insight (1) and (2) principles*: AFI(1) as 'affirmation' — the vibrational agent that 'dictates how transformation is to be arrived at (if a given situation is out of phase with its own essence factor)' — and AFI(2) as 'celebration' — the vibrational flow that 'moves towards composite knowingness on the physical plane.' (R)PART — the reality of participation — is crossed with AFL-DY (affinity dynamics). The diagram poses what *real* participation, not symbolic or token participation, requires structurally to align with affinity dynamics. (PO)TH-CONT — the *position of* thrust continuance, using Braxton's (PO) prefix from the CODE notation — feeds two outputs: PRI-INFO (primary information) and AFL-DY. AFL-DY then feeds PART (the subject) and PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance). PROJ-CONT branches to AFL (affinity alignment), (C)RC (the concept of race), and (R)POST (the reality of postulation). The structural argument: real participation is not voluntaristic — it is generated by the position of thrust continuance flowing through affinity dynamics, and its downstream produces projectional continuance whose terminal nodes are alignment, race, and postulation. Race appears here as a *conceptual* node (the (c) prefix), not a primary thing — Braxton's diagrammatic insistence that race is a concept emerging from projectional continuance, not a precondition of it.
